name: regulane
description: Free compliance check for your code, mapped to ISO 27001 and the DPDP Act.

interface.shortDescription: Check your code against ISO 27001 and DPDP secure-coding rules
interface.longDescription: Codex checks your code against Regulane's 34 secure-coding rules, each mapped to ISO 27001 Annex A controls and, for personal data, the DPDP Act 2023, then returns a scorecard with the fix for each finding. Free and without an account. Regulane never receives your code: only file paths, line numbers and one-sentence findings.
defaultPrompt: Run a Regulane compliance check on my uncommitted changes
Is this app's handling of personal data DPDP compliant? Check it with Regulane
